Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:98239: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Fix out-of-bounds write in kfd_event_page_set() (CVE-2026-43206)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Fix watch_id bounds checking in debug address watch v2 (CVE-2026-45878)

* kernel: procfs: fix missing RCU protection when reading real_parent in do_task_stat() (CVE-2026-46259)

* kernel: netfilter: nf_queue: hold bridge skb->dev while queued (CVE-2026-52912)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Fix buffer overflow in SDMA queue checkpoint/restore on GFX11 (CVE-2026-53143)

* kernel: drm/amd/display: Clamp VBIOS HDMI retimer register count to array size (CVE-2026-53136)

* kernel: Bluetooth: RFCOMM: validate skb length in MCC handlers (CVE-2026-53254)

* kernel: drm/amd/display: Use krealloc_array() in dal_vector_reserve() (CVE-2026-53329)

* kernel: drm/i915/gem: Fix phys BO pread/pwrite with offset (CVE-2026-53356)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: zero-initialize GART table on allocation (CVE-2026-53374)

* kernel: net: ip_gre: require CAP_NET_ADMIN in the device netns for changelink (CVE-2026-63829)

* kernel: scsi: scsi_transport_fc: Widen FPIN pname walker counter to u32 (CVE-2026-63889)

* kernel: drm/i915: Fix potential UAF in TTM object purge (CVE-2026-63884)

* kernel: tunnels: do not assume transport header in iptunnel_pmtud_check_icmp() (CVE-2026-63992)

* kernel: tunnels: load network headers after skb_cow() in iptunnel_pmtud_build_icmp[v6]() (CVE-2026-63994)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: fix amdgpu_hmm_range_get_pages (CVE-2026-63879)

* kernel: drm/amd/display: Validate payload length and link_index in dc_process_dmub_aux_transfer_async (CVE-2026-64219)

* kernel: Linux kernel: libceph stack out-of-bounds write via crafted OSDMap (CVE-2026-68159)

* kernel: Linux kernel: libceph null pointer dereference leads to denial of service (CVE-2026-68157)

* kernel: libceph: refresh auth->authorizer_buf{,_len} after authorizer update (CVE-2026-68156)

* kernel: Linux kernel (libceph): Denial of Service due to malformed monitor maps (CVE-2026-68155)

* kernel: vxlan: require CAP_NET_ADMIN in the device netns for changelink (CVE-2026-68432)

* kernel: ipvs: reload ip header after head reallocation (CVE-2026-68476)

* kernel: net: ip6_gre: require CAP_NET_ADMIN in the device netns for changelink (CVE-2026-72052)

* kernel: netfilter: nf_queue: pin bridge device while NFQUEUE holds fake dst (CVE-2026-72255)

* kernel: netfilter: nf_conntrack_sip: widen NAT rewrite delta to s32 in sip_help_tcp() (CVE-2026-74569)

* kernel: ipvs: clear IPv4 options after rebasing tunnel ICMP errors (CVE-2026-74669)

* kernel: ipvs: do not propagate one-packet flag to synced conns (CVE-2026-80714)

* kernel: nvme-tcp: fix host memory disclosure on R2T for a read command (CVE-2026-89481)

* kernel: nvme: add missing SRCU grace period in error path (CVE-2026-89972)

* kernel: nvme/ioctl: check SUBMIT_IO with nvme_cmd_allowed() (CVE-2026-90227)

* kernel: netfilter: nf_conntrack: use get_unaligned_be32() in tcp_sack() (CVE-2026-97417)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* kernel panic in percpu_counter_add_batch() via submit_bio_noacct() due to NULL pointer [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-279598)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
